description: Stations de traitement des eaux usées de Troyes Champagne Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Troyes Champagne Métropole. The waste water treatment system is a work of depollution of waste water by various processes: biological, physico-chemical... located on a continuous and homogeneous geographical space. It is urban, industrial or mixed depending on the nature of the contracting authority. Coverage: Troyes Champagne Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Troyes Champagne Métropole wastewater treatment plants" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Troyes Champagne Métropole. Its keywords include stations-de-traitement-des-eaux-usees, troyes-champagne-metropole. The listing shows 4 download or service links in GPKG, CSV, XLSX, PDF. The listing shows 2024-08-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
